_readme: Real QS client webinar campaigns, shown on the ROI Model tab beside the prospect's own projection. Every figure is a CAMPAIGN TOTAL across every run that client did, read from the Airtable Clients row (Webinars run / Total invites / Total registrations / Total attendees / Total booked calls). Single-webinar figures live in separate Airtable fields and are NOT used here - one event understates a client by 10-30x. Source of truth: Airtable base appDBh76I8NAiE4l8, table Clients (tblGRxbKEYh9NoLqV). In production this is GET /api/jobs/:id/roi-comparisons.
_selection_rule: Cherry-picked on campaign booked calls. Clients whose total is weak never appear here even when they are strong proof on another tab - GoHire (4 calls across 19 runs) and Horton (3 across 12) are deliberately excluded.
_two_evidence_classes: stats_basis says where a client's totals came from. 'Workshop stats database' is tracked per-run measurement. 'Client interview (self-reported)' is the client's own account - from a recorded case-study interview (Cedric) or the QS testimonial sheet (Felix, Tejas) - real and quotable, but never independently measured and usually missing steps. Self-reported cards are badged as such on the tab, and render only the steps the client actually stated.
_invites_caveat: Invites are SENDS across runs, not unique people. The same contact is invited to several webinars, so total invites exceeds the market size. Label it 'invites sent', never 'people reached'.
_shape_note: No client has LTV or close rate on file, so no dollar ROI can be shown for them. Display the funnel and the booked-call count, never a revenue figure.
_matching: Alex's rule (2026-09-04 training, 1:07:33): lead with the client whose TAM is closest to the prospect's, regardless of what they sell.
